simple.meaning: כָּתַשׁ (kâthash) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to butt or pound.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Proverbs, beginning at Proverbs 27:22. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כָּתַשׁ (H3806) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: כָּתַשׁ (kâthash) / H3806 is traced through Proverbs 27:22 with source-language evidence and verse context.
